businessInfo.name: BayState Plumbing & HVAC
businessInfo.demoNotice: Demo website — fictional business, sample reviews and illustrative pricing. License, ratings, response times, financing and warranties are not verified. Not a live service provider.
businessInfo.tagline: 24/7 emergency plumbing, heating & cooling for Worcester County. Flat-rate pricing, no surprises.
businessInfo.description: Licensed Worcester, MA plumbers and HVAC techs on call 24/7. Burst pipes, water heaters, drain jetting, boiler tune-ups and sump pumps at upfront flat rates.

services.name: Burst Pipe & Leak Repair
services.description: We locate the leak, shut it down and repair copper, PEX or cast iron before water damage spreads.

services.name: Water Heater Repair & Install
services.description: Same-day repair or replacement of gas, electric and tankless water heaters, old tank hauled away.

services.name: Main Drain Hydro-Jetting
services.description: High-pressure jetting clears roots, grease and scale from your main line, with a camera inspection after.

services.name: Boiler & Furnace Tune-Up
services.description: Combustion test, cleaning and safety check so your heat makes it through a New England winter.

services.name: Sump Pump Replacement
services.description: New pump, check valve and optional battery backup to keep your basement dry in spring thaw.

services.name: Frozen Pipe Thawing
services.description: Safe electric thawing with no open flame, plus insulation advice so the line does not freeze again.

reviews.author: Maureen D.
reviews.text: A pipe burst in our basement at 2 a.m. in January. They were at the door in 35 minutes, had the water off and the line repaired before sunrise, and charged exactly the price quoted on the phone.

reviews.author: Carlos R.
reviews.text: Our restaurant's main drain backed up on a Friday afternoon. BayState hydro-jetted the line and showed us the camera footage. We were open for dinner service that night.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: The 20-year-old water heater in our triple-decker finally quit. They quoted a flat rate, installed the new one the same day and hauled the old tank away. No upsell, no mess.

faqs.question: Do you charge overtime for nights, weekends or holidays?
faqs.answer: No. Our flat rates are the same at 2 a.m. on a Sunday as they are on a Tuesday afternoon. You approve the price before any work starts.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water heater, boiler and furnace replacements over $1,000 qualify for 0% financing for 12 months, subject to credit approval. Mass Save HEAT Loan paperwork is handled for you.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with your work?
faqs.answer: Every repair carries a 2-year parts and labor warranty. New equipment also keeps its full manufacturer warranty, which we register on your behalf.

faqs.question: Are estimates free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Estimates for replacements and installs are free. For repairs, the diagnostic fee is waived when you go ahead with the work.

faqs.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. We hold a Massachusetts Master Plumber license, our techs are licensed for gas and oil heat, and we carry general liability and workers' compensation insurance.
